newsitem.title: USA: Citigate forms partnership with Bass Yager.
newsitem.headline: Citigate forms partnership with Bass Yager.

text.p: Bass Yager and Lloyd Northover Citigate, a division of the Citigate Group, said Tuesday they formed a strategic marketing and creative partnership.
Citigate forms part of Incepta Group Plc.

Herb Yager, president of Bass Yager, said "Since the death of Saul Bass last year, we have been looking for ways to develop the business for the future ... this partnership signals the beginning of a new era for our company."

Bass Yager said it has changed its name to Bass Yager Citigate and the firms have formed an international executive team to coordinate their strategy and marketing. The senior management of Bass Yager will remain in place.
Bass Yager is an independent company with offices in Los Angeles and representation in Japan.

The Citigate Group is a public relations and advertising agency, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, South Africa, New York, San Francisco and representation in the Middle East and throughout Europe.
Incepta Group is a British marketing and publishing firm.
